summary: Signal Stage is a multiplayer 3D motion-graphics stage whose shared 3:18 track and camera flight start or cut from P/ROLL. The active structure is a single place with a small set of blueprint placeholder objects, a shared score/shot clock consumed by camera, HUD and director, and ordinary player movement between rolls.
places: places/main/config.yaml (main place) - 3D, terrain off, black linear fog, default look, spawn at (0, 0.1, 16), gravity -24Y; stage floor and blueprint field/eye objects are in x0z0.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - placed director, field, eye and static stage-floor; field and eye are generic blueprint boxes, director runs scripts/stage.js.
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - placed tunnel blueprint box centered at (0, 9, -186), 300 m long.
places/main/cells/x0z-3.scene - placed chamber blueprint box at (0, -9, -362), 50×48×50 m.
roots: world.config.yaml - multiplayer world entry: main place, player/camera templates, P/jump/movement inputs, arrival, lighting, HUD and nametag.
templates/player.js#player - character root composing humanoid locomotion and player movement/input.
templates/camera.js#camera - custom first-person look camera with scripts/camera.js cinematic override.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene#director - all-audience director behavior; controls shared track and trip start parameters.
scripts/ui.js - per-viewer idle ROLL or rolling progress/cut HUD.
shared: scripts/lib/cine.js - CPU clock, score/shot access, section lookup and camera interpolation used by player, camera, director and HUD.
scripts/lib/data/score.yml and scripts/lib/data/shots.yml - shared track timing/sections/layout and camera keyframes consumed via cine.js.
scripts/lib/trip.js - shader-node clock/palette helpers and score data; no active scripted-material, sky or look consumer is present in the current tree.
scripts/lighting.js and scripts/look-default.js - world lighting function and main-place screen look.
scripts/lib/data/player.yml and scripts/lib/data/camera.yml - movement tuning and first-person eye height.
notableExports: scripts/player.js - exports onInput, update; scripts/camera.js - exports finiteNumber, update.
scripts/stage.js - exports update; scripts/lib/cine.js - exports SCORE, SHOTS, CINE, cineTime, sectionAt, cameraAt, beatEnv.
scripts/lib/trip.js - exports SCORE, SEC, BPS, tripClock, win, pal, stripes, HUE.
scripts/ui.js - exports default; scripts/arrival.js - exports onArrive, onLeave; ui/nametag.js - exports default.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - exports sit, onInput, update; sim.js - exports cadence, tick.
scripts/lighting.js - exports lighting; scripts/look-default.js - exports look.
ownership: scripts/player.js - owns player movement intent in its namespaced local session and writes world.state.cine = {start, by} or null on cine input.
scripts/stage.js on #director - owns director session key/count and state.track/audio; writes t0/on to materials tagged trip and to place look/sky params.
scripts/camera.js / templates/camera.js - owns camera-local rolling session and camera pose/FOV; follows shared shot then returns to look orientation.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - owns avatar locomotion/sit animation and its local gait scratch; scripts/player.js owns movement velocity and input intent.
places/main/config.yaml - owns place atmosphere, spawn, gravity and terrain mode; world.config.yaml owns world services, inputs and templates.
scripts/ui.js and ui/nametag.js - viewer-local presentation only; neither owns shared cinematic state.
flows: world.config.yaml cine action (P) or HUD sendAction('cine') → scripts/player.js onInput → world.state.cine = {start: now + 300 ms, by} or null.
scripts/lib/data/score.yml + shots.yml → scripts/lib/cine.js cineTime/cameraAt → each scripts/camera.js update flies its viewer through the shared keyframes.
world.state.cine → scripts/ui.js render → idle ROLL button, or letterbox/progress/section label and CUT button.
world.state.cine + score music → placed scripts/stage.js director → non-spatial audio with timeAt=c.start; director clears track/audio when the roll ends or is cut.

scripts/stage.js → objects tagged trip material.params.t0/on and place atmosphere look/sky params; current three blueprint stage objects are not tagged trip, and the active look/sky do not provide trip shader consumers.
scripts/lib/data/score.yml → scripts/lib/trip.js tripClock/palette helpers; intended shared shader clock, but no current scene material imports it.
world.config.yaml moveX/moveZ/jump → scripts/player.js onInput/update → character velocity; templates/player.js also runs humanoid locomotion.
templates/camera.js orientation.source=look → scripts/camera.js ordinary first-person pose; world.config.yaml arrival behavior → scripts/arrival.js.
world.config.yaml lighting/ui.render/nametag → scripts/lighting.js, scripts/ui.js and ui/nametag.js.
behaviorFamilies: templates/player.js composes scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js and scripts/player.js on each character: locomotion owns gait/animation; player behavior owns movement input and body velocity.
probableOrphans: scripts/lib/trip.js - shader clock/palette helpers have no active material, sky or look imports in the current tree.
scripts/flat-starter-terrain.js - old terrain generator; main terrain is explicitly off.
scripts/flower.js, scripts/grass.js, scripts/grass-look.js and scripts/pebble.js - meadow decoration geometry/material with no current place consumer.
scripts/lib/data/world.yml - terrain baseHeight data with no active terrain consumer apparent.
migrationNotes: world.state.cine remains the shared start/cut source; starts are scheduled 300 ms ahead for room-wide synchronization.
scripts/lib/cine.js uses milliseconds for c.start/ctx.now() and seconds for score and camera keys; scripts/stage.js converts start to shader time seconds modulo 3600.
scripts/stage.js requires the placed #director and currently propagates shader params only to objects tagged trip; don't assume blueprint-tagged field/eye/tunnel/chamber boxes are animated geometry.
The director alone plays the non-spatial music at gain 0.8 using timeAt=c.start; camera/HUD derive time from the same world.state.cine.
Player/world coordinates are metres, +Y up; main spawn is (0, 0.1, 16), gravity is -24Y, and player template default feetPosition y=2 is separate.

design.md describes proposed field/eye/tunnel/chamber/serpent shader pieces and scripts/sky.js/look-trip.js, but those files and corresponding trip-tagged scene objects are absent; current place uses look-default and realistic sky.
